user.title: Connect to your GoodWe ETA inverter
user.description: Connect directly to the GoodWe ETA over Modbus TCP. Give the inverter a static IP address or DHCP reservation before continuing.

data_description.host: Fixed IP address of the GoodWe ETA inverter.

controller.title: Configure EnergyPilot and EMHASS
controller.description: EMHASS must already be installed, running and configured. Keep Automatic Control OFF until Optimize now completes successfully and publishes numeric P_batt and P_grid targets. The GoodWe smart-meter actuator strategy can be selected later under the dashboard GOODWE settings.

data.p_batt_entity: EMHASS battery power target entity ID
data.p_grid_entity: EMHASS grid power target entity ID
data.emhass_soc_final_pct: Target SOC at end of optimization

data_description.p_batt_entity: Standard ID: sensor.p_batt_forecast. Negative means planned charge; positive means planned discharge. It is the direct actuator target when GoodWe smart-meter control is OFF.
data_description.p_grid_entity: Standard ID: sensor.p_grid_forecast. Positive means planned import; negative means planned export. With GoodWe smart-meter control ON it drives modes 9/10 and mode 1 around zero.
data_description.optim_status_entity: Standard ID: sensor.optim_status. It can be entered before EMHASS creates the entity.
data_description.optim_required_state: EnergyPilot executes EMHASS targets only when this state matches. Standard: Optimal.
data_description.max_power_kw: Caps the GoodWe mode-specific setpoint: PCC import/export target with smart-meter control ON, or direct battery target with it OFF.
data_description.deadband: Tolerance around 0 W. Applied to P_grid with smart-meter control ON and to P_batt with it OFF. Recommended: 300 W.
data_description.scan_interval: How often EnergyPilot polls the inverter. Recommended: 10 seconds. v0.22 does not run the former 30-second mode-11 grid-neutral feedback loop when PCC control is enabled.
data_description.enable_emhass_orchestrator: Runs optimization and publish independently from Automatic Control.
data_description.emhass_url: Default Home Assistant EMHASS add-on URL: http://5b918bf2-emhass:5000.
data_description.emhass_optimization_interval: Choose 15, 30 or 60 minutes. Recommended: 15 minutes. Scheduled runs start at fixed wall-clock boundaries plus 15 seconds; event triggers still run immediately.
data_description.emhass_soc_final_pct: Runtime soc_final target. This does not replace the EMHASS minimum/maximum SOC limits.
data_description.emhass_fallback_load: Used only when live and historical house-load data are not plausible.
data_description.use_nordpool_prices: Uses nordpool.get_prices_for_date when available, otherwise a sensor with raw_today/raw_tomorrow. Disable this to use the price method configured inside EMHASS.
data_description.optimize_on_tomorrow_prices: Immediately creates a new plan when tomorrow prices become available.
data_description.nordpool_area: Optional market area such as NL. Leave empty to use the detected area/source.
data_description.buy_price_adder: Variable supplier fees, taxes or additions in EUR/kWh.
data_description.sell_price_deduction: Amount deducted from the market export price in EUR/kWh.
data_description.enable_ev_coordination: Holds the battery while EV charging is active and re-optimizes when charging stops.
data_description.ev_power_entity: Optional EV charging-power entity in watts.
data_description.ev_online_entity: Optional entity that reports whether the EV charger is reachable.
data_description.ev_deadband: Power above this threshold is considered active EV charging.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the GoodWe ETA or read EMS registers 47511/47512. Verify IP address, port, Unit ID and Modbus TCP availability.

abort.already_configured: This GoodWe ETA inverter is already configured.

init.title: GW EnergyPilot options
init.description: Configure EnergyPilot, EMHASS orchestration, runtime prices and optional EV coordination. The GoodWe smart-meter actuator strategy is configured under the dashboard GOODWE page.

data.p_batt_entity: EMHASS battery power target entity ID
data.p_grid_entity: EMHASS grid power target entity ID
data.emhass_soc_final_pct: Target SOC at end of optimization

data_description.p_batt_entity: Standard ID: sensor.p_batt_forecast. Direct battery actuator output when GoodWe smart-meter control is OFF.
data_description.p_grid_entity: Standard ID: sensor.p_grid_forecast. PCC import/export actuator output when GoodWe smart-meter control is ON.
data_description.max_power_kw: Maximum GoodWe mode-specific setpoint in kW.
data_description.deadband: Recommended: 300 W. Applies to P_grid in PCC mode or P_batt in direct-battery mode.
data_description.enable_emhass_orchestrator: Enables wall-clock and event-driven optimization plus active plan-step publication.
data_description.emhass_optimization_interval: Choose 15, 30 or 60 minutes. Recommended: 15 minutes. Fixed wall-clock boundaries run at +15 seconds.
data_description.emhass_fallback_load: Fallback only; normal operation uses GoodWe load plus Recorder history.
data_description.use_nordpool_prices: Disable to let EMHASS use its own configured price method.
data_description.nordpool_area: Optional market area such as NL.
data_description.enable_ev_coordination: Optional EV hold and stop-triggered re-optimization.
data_description.ev_power_entity: Optional EV charging-power entity in watts.
data_description.ev_online_entity: Optional entity that reports whether the EV charger is reachable.
data_description.ev_deadband: Power above this threshold is considered active EV charging.
